description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter mobile application. It sets up the app structure, including the main widget, theme customization, and the home page ui with a loading indicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, sets up MaterialApp with theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the home page with a customizable title.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class managing the build method for MyHomePage, displaying app bar and body content.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, executes runApp with MyApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method of MyApp and _MyHomePageState, constructs the widget tree for each respective class.
